stopping_diagnostics.interpretation: Constrained artificial training-marker removal with shared-task protection; not proof of removing all real-data contribution

limitations: One candidate and one training seed do not establish general scientific validity
Family independence is conditional on the synthetic input-probe generator
Fixed preprocessing retains all four clients training contribution
No heldout fake/no-op or overdestruction detection rate is measured
Full, Initial and retained FL reference are reused from v2; no new federated training occurred
The v10 checkpoint stopping candidate was informed by v2-v8 and the training-only v9 numerical diagnostic; all historical observation roles are excluded from fresh probes

Only the predeclared feasible Armijo candidate reaches new calibration and audit; head and proxy budgets and balanced objective remain fixed while only the candidate stopping check interval changes to 100
Selective intervention in artificial training markers is not proof of removing every original target-data contribution
